drafts.title: Reset password + API rate limits
drafts.content:
Hi there,

Happy to help with the password reset. Just head to the sign-in page and click “Forgot password” — a reset email will arrive within about five minutes. If it doesn’t show up, check your spam folder and make sure you’re using the email on file.

On API rate limits: I want to get you an accurate answer rather than guess, so I’m checking with our team on the current limits and will follow up shortly.

Best,
[Your name]
